title: Latin texts deposited on the Nakala repository (Huma-Num)
notes: 109 French and Latin texts (1458-1698) deposited on Nakala, the research-data repository of Huma-Num (CNRS), as individual datasets carrying no project-level metadata. We searched the Nakala platform and the RQ attributions manifest but could not identify the depositor or the scholarly project the texts belong to, so this entry documents a platform-level deposit only; the underlying datasets remain accessible through the frozen RQ release referenced here and their harvest reference is 'Nakala (Huma-Num, nakala.fr)'. Corpus statistics (text, word and language counts, period) derived from the RQ Open Corpus snapshot v2026.06 (in-core, deduplicated texts).
institution: Nakala, research-data repository of Huma-Num (CNRS) and IRD
